attempts.summary: Configured a dedicated node2 uploader identity that submits newline-delimited batches to node1 through a forced SSH command. Each submission becomes one atomic, byte-exact receipt. Arbitrary commands, shells, PTYs, and forwarding are denied. Existing data, administrative SSH behavior, RHEL 10.0, kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1, SELinux, firewall, and packages were preserved. Both nodes passed isolated restart and recovery testing.
